podcast.title: CrimeTimeSnacks • A True Crime Podcast
podcast.subtitle: Exploring unsolved cases, murders, and mysteries.
podcast.description: CrimeTimeSnacks is a true crime podcast exploring unsolved cases, murders, and mysteries with detailed analysis and compelling storytelling. Hosted by Cory.
podcast.author: Cory

episodes.title: A Hero at the Wilmington DMV: The Heroism of Corporal Matthew Snook
episodes.description: The tragic and heroic events that unfolded at the Wilmington DMV on December 23, 2025, and the ultimate sacrifice of Corporal Matthew Snook, a Delaware State Police officer whose heroism saved lives.

episodes.title: Murders in Moscow
episodes.description: The Idaho student murders that rocked the nation — the victims, the investigation, and the arrest of Bryan Kohberger.

episodes.title: Erik and Lyle: The Menendez Brothers
episodes.description: Convicted in 1996 for the 1989 murders of their parents, Lyle and Erik Menendez have been in prison for over 35 years. We revisit the case.
